description: This file defines the SaveNationalityController class, which extends an abstract Vue controller. It is responsible for preparing Vue components related to nationality data, specifically choosing between 'nationality-edit' and 'nationality-save' components based on request attributes.

classes.name: SaveNationalityController
classes.description: Controller class that manages the Vue components for saving or editing nationality data based on request parameters.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component to be rendered, choosing the appropriate component ('nationality-edit' or 'nationality-save') based on whether an 'id' attribute exists in the request.
